d:
Reserved, media-shy, and a relative newcomer to Israeli politics, former military chief Gadi Eisenkot presents a clear contrast to Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, the veteran leader he aims to defeat in an election next week. His image as a straight-talking security hawk from humble roots has resonated in a nation going to ​the polls on October 27 for the first time since Hamas attacked Israel three years ago.
Production: Nikita Agarwal
Video Editor: Shakir Khan
